package: K27 export through local Next HTTP with Better Auth and PostgreSQL

runtime.better_auth: real configured instance and signed pp.session_token cookie

vitest.command: DATABASE_URL=<disposable> DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED=<disposable> npx vitest run --config vitest.postgres.config.ts tests/postgres/user-export-http.pg.test.ts

observed: Signed live owner cookie returned 200 with Cache-Control: no-store and attachment disposition.
Export response contained the owner's comment and excluded another user's comment on the same video.
After deleting the session row, the same signed cookie returned 401.
Synthetic user count was zero after test teardown.
scope_limits: The server runs in local Next development mode; production build and reverse proxy were not part of this test.
Rate limiting used the actual in-memory development store; no Redis or Cloudflare service was used.
This covers only the seeded account and comment categories, not every K27 data category or K37 export scale/streaming.
K05/K11/K26 policy and data-dependency review, K37, and independent code review remain open.
